items.headline: Keldric Luster throws 3 early touchdown passes and Ball State defeats Stony Brook 41-17
items.description: — Keldric Luster threw three touchdown passes in the first half and Ball State defeated Stony Brook 41-17 on Saturday for the Cardinals’ fourth-straight home opening win.

items.headline: Smith and Sayin help No. 1 Ohio State prepare for Texas with 56-3 rout of Ball State
items.description: — Jeremiah Smith had two highlight reel-worthy touchdown catches, Julian Sayin passed for 320 yards and three touchdowns, and top-ranked Ohio State tuned up for next week's matchup against No. 5 Texas with a 56-3 rout of Ball State on Saturday.
